title: Role-Play in the Marketplace
notes: The free Role-Play extension is now in the Marketplace — members create characters and post as them, with role-play topics, a dice roller, character sheets and a character directory. Plus the role-play core hooks, Ask moved into the left sidebar, and the reading-scrubber footer fix.

changelog.text: The free Role-Play extension is now in the Marketplace — install it on demand to let members create characters and post as them, with role-play topics, a dice roller, character sheets and a character directory.
PostIdentity hook + composer context — the foundation for role-play forums, where members post as characters.
Ask now sits in the left sidebar under the categories list, freeing the main column for the discussion list.
The reading-progress scrubber no longer overlaps the footer at the bottom of a thread — it stays visible and slides up just above it.
